name: board-r1
note: Emoji audit pass 3 (owner, 2026-11-07): the board's last emoji. Growing-plot art for the farmplots (seedling mounds with variants, a young vine, a young shrub, a sapling), the eight signposts and the dungeon exit on the grid; the Dungeon Entrance (2 x 2), the Mountain (one art for the three sizes), the Volcano and the Big Statue as single panels for cutout.js.

plots.prompt: CAMERA AND STYLE REFERENCE: the first attached panel is a building from this game, drawn in the game's camera (top-down three-quarter: the object seen from the front and from above at once, verticals straight up) and in its painterly storybook rendering; match that camera and rendering exactly, the same brush texture, the same warm full daylight from high up and a little left, the same soft shadows only in the recesses, and SQUARE-ON: each object's front face parallel to the bottom edge, never turned on the diagonal. The second attached image is this game's OAK TREE: its leaf colour and paint are the reference for every green here. SUBJECTS, nine small 1 x 1 board objects, in order on the grid, left to right then top to bottom: 1 SEEDLINGS A: a low mound of dark tilled earth with a row of four young green seedlings just sprouted, two leaves each. 2 SEEDLINGS B: the same mound with five seedlings a little taller, leaning different ways. 3 SEEDLINGS C: the same mound with three seedlings and a few small stones. 4 YOUNG VINE: a short wooden trellis of two stakes and a crossbar with a young green vine climbing it, no fruit. 5 YOUNG SHRUB: a small round leafy shrub in a mound of earth, glossy dark green leaves, no berries. 6 SAPLING: a young oak sapling tied to a stake with twine, a few leaves. 7 STAIRS UP: a short flight of worn stone steps rising toward the back into a dark arched opening, a warm light at the top: the way OUT of a dungeon. 8 SEEDLINGS D: the mound with six tiny seedlings in two rows. 9 YOUNG VINE B: the trellis with the vine a little fuller. The LAST attached image is the layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field divided into a 3 x 3 grid of cells; draw ONE object per cell, centred and well inside its cell with clear magenta around it, never touching a grid line, every cell on the same flat magenta with no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass.
